segments.text: to allow them to go to completion in a reasonable time period. If these reactions were heated
segments.zh: 才能在合理的时间内反应完全。如果这些反应

segments.text: in a closed container, crushed airway fills up inside the container and it may explode.
segments.zh: 在密闭容器中加热，容器内会积聚压力，可能会爆炸。

segments.text: If these reactions were heated in an open container, then the solvent may evaporate from the system.
segments.zh: 如果这些反应在敞口容器中加热，溶剂就可能从体系中蒸发掉。

segments.text: The method of refluxing solves both of the above problems by allowing a chemist to heat
segments.zh: 回流的方法同时解决了上述两个问题，使化学工作者能够

segments.text: a reaction at its boiling point without any materials evaporating or any containers exploding.
segments.zh: 在沸点下加热反应，而不会有任何物质蒸发掉，也不会有任何容器爆炸。

segments.text: Refluxing works by heating a solution to boiling and condensing the resulting vapor by continuous
segments.zh: 回流的原理是把溶液加热至沸腾，并通过持续冷却

segments.text: cooling. Because approximately 80 percent of all organic reactions involve refluxing,
segments.zh: 使产生的蒸气冷凝。由于大约 80% 的有机反应都涉及回流，

segments.text: this technique is an important one to understand. To carry out a reflux, you will need a cork ring,
segments.zh: 这是一项需要理解的重要技术。进行回流，你需要一个软木圈、

segments.text: a round bottom flask, a stir plate in stir bar or boiling stones, a condenser, grease,
segments.zh: 一个圆底烧瓶、一个搅拌器和搅拌子或沸石、一根冷凝管、真空脂、

segments.text: a ring stand, two extension clamps with fasteners, two pieces of thin walled rubber tubing,
segments.zh: 一个铁架台、两个带固定夹的延长夹、两根薄壁橡胶管、

segments.text: three hose clips, a heating mantle, an iron ring, and a variac. The first step of refluxing involves
segments.zh: 三个软管夹、一个加热套、一个铁圈，以及一台调压变压器（Variac）。回流的第一步是

segments.text: choosing an appropriate solvent. A good refluxing solvent will dissolve all of the reagents but not
segments.zh: 选择合适的溶剂。好的回流溶剂能溶解所有试剂，但不

segments.text: react with them and it will boil at a temperature high enough to allow the reaction to proceed
segments.zh: 与它们反应，而且它的沸点要足够高，使反应能

segments.text: rapidly. After choosing your solvent, dissolve all of the reagents in it and transfer the solution
segments.zh: 快速进行。选好溶剂后，把所有试剂溶解在其中，再把溶液转移

segments.text: to a round bottom flask. The round bottom flask should be no more than half full. Then add either
segments.zh: 到圆底烧瓶中。圆底烧瓶的装液量不应超过一半。然后往溶液中加入

segments.text: a stir bar or boiling stones to the solution to avoid bumping. Bumping is the eruption of large
segments.zh: 搅拌子或沸石，以防暴沸。暴沸是指溶液由于过热而突然冒出大

segments.text: bubbles from a solution due to super heating which results in material loss or even a fire.
segments.zh: 气泡，会导致物料损失，甚至引起火灾。

segments.text: Magnetic stirrers disallow bumping because they create turbulence in the solution
segments.zh: 磁力搅拌器能防止暴沸，因为它们会在溶液中造成湍流，

segments.text: which disrupt the large bubbles. Boiling stones are also able to disrupt the large bubbles
segments.zh: 打碎大气泡。沸石也能打碎大气泡，

segments.text: because these porous materials produce a steady stream of fine air bubbles when heated in a
segments.zh: 因为这些多孔材料在溶剂中受热时，会产生一串稳定的

segments.text: solvent. Always place boiling stones in the solution before heating. If boiling stones
segments.zh: 细小气泡。一定要在加热之前把沸石放入溶液。如果把沸石

segments.text: are added to a hot solution, the liquid may instantaneously boil and shoot out of the
segments.zh: 加入热的溶液中，液体可能会瞬间沸腾并从

segments.text: flask. To assemble the reflux apparatus, clamp the round bottom flask containing your sample to
segments.zh: 烧瓶中喷出。组装回流装置时，把装有样品的圆底烧瓶夹在

segments.text: a ring stand. Lightly grease the male end of the condenser and attach it to the round bottom flask.
segments.zh: 铁架台上。在冷凝管的内磨口端薄薄地涂上真空脂，把它接到圆底烧瓶上。

segments.text: Attach the water inlet tubing to the bottom connection and the water outlet tubing to the
segments.zh: 把进水管接到下方的接口上，出水管接到

segments.text: top connection. Secure the tubing with hose clips to prevent the tubes from popping off
segments.zh: 上方的接口上。用软管夹固定橡胶管，以防水压变化导致橡胶管脱落

segments.text: and flooding the lab due to pressure changes in the water. Secure an appropriately sized
segments.zh: 而淹了实验室。在烧瓶下方固定一个大小合适的

segments.text: heating mantle and iron ring below the flask. If you do not have an appropriately sized heating
segments.zh: 加热套和铁圈。如果你没有大小合适的加热

segments.text: mantle, then use one that is too big. Never use a heating mantle that is too small because heat is
segments.zh: 套，那就用一个偏大的。绝不要用太小的加热套，因为

segments.text: not easily transferred between the mantle and glass due to port contact, which causes the mantle to
segments.zh: 接触不良，热量不容易在加热套和玻璃之间传递，这会导致加热套

segments.text: burn out. If the mantle is too big for the flask, then add sand to fill in the spaces.
segments.zh: 烧坏。如果加热套对于烧瓶来说太大，就加沙子填满空隙。

segments.text: Finally, plug the heating mantle into a variable voltage transformer or variac. Never directly
segments.zh: 最后，把加热套插到调压变压器（Variac）上，绝不要直接

segments.text: into the wall. Before starting the reflux, make sure that the apparatus is open at the top of
segments.zh: 插到墙上的插座上。开始回流之前，确保装置在冷凝管顶部

segments.text: the condenser. Never heat a closed system because the pressure buildup may cause an explosion.
segments.zh: 是敞开的。绝不要加热密闭体系，因为压力积聚可能会引起爆炸。

segments.text: To reflux a reaction, double check that all of the joints are secured with hose clips and
segments.zh: 进行回流反应时，再次检查所有接口是否都已用软管夹固定，然后

segments.text: start the water flow. Slowly increase the setting on the variac until the solution begins a gentle
segments.zh: 开始通水。慢慢调高 Variac 的设定值，直到溶液开始缓缓

segments.text: boil. You will see a ring of vapor or condensate form above the solution. This vapor enters the
segments.zh: 沸腾。你会看到溶液上方形成一圈蒸气或冷凝液。这些蒸气进入

segments.text: condenser, cools, and the resulting liquid drops back into the flask. Carefully adjust the amount
segments.zh: 冷凝管，冷却后，生成的液体滴回烧瓶中。仔细调节

segments.text: of heat that is delivered to the solution so that the ring of condensate stabilizes about halfway
segments.zh: 对溶液的加热量，使冷凝液圈稳定在冷凝管大约一半

segments.text: up the condenser. If the ring is too high, sample may be lost out of the condenser.
segments.zh: 的高度。如果冷凝液圈太高，样品可能会从冷凝管中跑掉。

segments.text: If the ring is too low, then the reaction will occur over too long of a time period.
segments.zh: 如果冷凝液圈太低，反应所需的时间就会太长。

segments.text: After the reflux is finished, remove the heat, let the round bottom flask cool,
segments.zh: 回流结束后，撤去热源，让圆底烧瓶冷却，

segments.text: and shut off the water. During your laboratory experiences, you may need to run your reflux under
segments.zh: 再关掉水。在你的实验学习过程中，你可能需要在干燥条件下

segments.text: dry conditions. To accomplish this, simply place a clean dry drying tube at the top of the condenser.
segments.zh: 进行回流。要做到这一点，只需在冷凝管顶部装一个洁净干燥的干燥管。

segments.text: This drying tube allows the system to be open while preventing the atmosphere from reaching
segments.zh: 这个干燥管能让体系保持敞开，同时防止空气接触到

segments.text: your solution. Alternatively, insert a T connector on the top of the condenser
segments.zh: 你的溶液。或者，在冷凝管顶部插一个 T 形接头，

segments.text: and connect the other two arms of the connector to a nitrogen source and a bubbler.
segments.zh: 把接头的另外两端分别接到氮气源和鼓泡器上。

segments.text: You may also wish to add reagents to your solution while the reflux is occurring.
segments.zh: 你可能还想在回流进行过程中往溶液中加入试剂。

segments.text: To accomplish this addition, you will need an addition funnel, which is a separatory funnel
segments.zh: 要进行这种加料，你需要一个滴液漏斗，也就是带有

segments.text: with a ground glass joint, a glass stopper that fits the funnel, and a Claisen adapter.
segments.zh: 磨口接头的分液漏斗，一个与漏斗匹配的玻璃塞，以及一个克莱森接头（Claisen adapter）。

segments.text: Simply fit the Claisen adapter on top of the round bottom flask,
segments.zh: 只需把克莱森接头装在圆底烧瓶的上方，

segments.text: attach the condenser to the joint directly above the round bottom flask,
segments.zh: 把冷凝管接在圆底烧瓶正上方的接口上，

segments.text: and attach the addition funnel to the side arm. Remember to grease all the joints.
segments.zh: 再把滴液漏斗接在侧口上。记得给所有接口涂上真空脂。

segments.text: Alternatively, you may use a three-necked flask in place of the single-necked flask in Claisen
segments.zh: 或者，你也可以用三口烧瓶代替单口烧瓶和克莱森

segments.text: adapter. Just remember to place a rubber septum on the remaining neck of the flask.
segments.zh: 接头。只要记得在烧瓶剩下的那个瓶口上装一个橡胶隔垫。

segments.text: If your addition funnel does not have a pressure-equalizing arm,
segments.zh: 如果你的滴液漏斗没有恒压侧管，

segments.text: then you must periodically remove the glass stopper to break the vacuum.
segments.zh: 那么你必须定期取下玻璃塞，以破除真空。

segments.text: Refluxing allows a canvas to heat a reaction over an extended time period
segments.zh: 回流使化学工作者能够长时间加热反应，

segments.text: without worrying about exploding glassware or solving an aberration.
segments.zh: 而不必担心玻璃仪器爆炸或溶剂蒸发。
